subject: Re: Dedicated vs Private VPC - data isolation follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver@finsecure.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated vs Private VPC - data isolation follow-up

Hi Oliver — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps.

Recap:
- FinSecure primary requirement: customer data must not be accessible to third-party tenants and must be stored/processed within customer-controlled infrastructure where possible.
- Deployment options we discussed:
  - Hosted API: fastest to launch, shared control plane and multi-tenant infra — NOT recommended given your isolation/KMS needs.
  - Dedicated (reserved capacity): isolated GPU pools and tenant separation at the serving layer; control plane remains managed by Redwood (logging/coordination in our control plane). Good for throughput predictability but limited for customer-managed KMS or full VPC control.
  - Private VPC / On-prem: control plane and serving inside your VPC or on-prem; supports customer-managed KMS, private networking, and full audit/log separation.

Clarifying questions (please confirm):
1) Do you require the control plane to be inside your VPC (i.e., no Redwood-managed control plane access)?
2) Is customer-managed KMS a hard requirement for encryption-at-rest and in-transit keys?
3) Do you need on-prem (air-gapped) option, or would Private VPC (cloud-hosted in your cloud account) suffice?
4) Any regulatory/regulator deadlines we should know about?

Next steps:
- Please fill the attached network_topology_request.xlsx with a point of contact for networking.
- I'm attaching our Private VPC feature brief and a redacted SOC2 report for your security team.
- If it helps, we can provision Dedicated as an interim while Private VPC setup runs — I'll coordinate timelines/estimates.

Available to schedule a technical deep-dive with our solutions architect next week. Proposed times: Tue/Wed AM PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(650) 555-0123

Attachments: network_topology_request.xlsx

From: Oliver Chen <oliver@finsecure.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated vs Private VPC - data isolation follow-up

Thanks Marissa — great summary.

Answers:
- Yes, control plane must be reachable only from our VPC (no Redwood-managed control plane allowed).
- Customer-managed KMS is required for at-rest keys.
- Private VPC hosted in our cloud account would be ideal; on-prem is preferred only if we can't meet latency through cloud peering.
- Target compliance delivery: Q3 2026.

Couple of clarifying Qs:
1) Does Dedicated offer any option for customer KMS or is that only with Private?
2) For Private VPC, do you support AWS PrivateLink/direct connect options for model traffic, or do we need to route through a public egress?
3) Can you share an estimate (order of magnitude) for Dedicated monthly commit vs Private one-time setup + monthly ops fee?

I've attached our security questionnaire (security@finsecure.com). Happy to join the deep-dive next week — Wed AM PT works.

Best,
Oliver
Oliver Chen
Head of Infrastructure, FinSecure
oliver@finsecure.com

Attachment: FinSecure_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated vs Private VPC - data isolation follow-up

Thanks Oliver — answers inline below.

On Sat, Mar 21, 2026 at 11:20 AM Oliver Chen <oliver@finsecure.com> wrote:
> 1) Does Dedicated offer any option for customer KMS or is that only with Private?
Dedicated: No customer-managed KMS for the control plane; we can encrypt KV/serving disk with customer keys at rest in some dedicated deployments via an enterprise agreement, but the control plane's metadata and audit store remain in Redwood-managed KMS. For full customer KMS separation we recommend Private VPC.
> 2) For Private VPC, do you support AWS PrivateLink/direct connect options for model traffic, or do we need to route through a public egress?
Private VPC: Yes — we support VPC peering, AWS PrivateLink and Direct Connect options for traffic. We'll need the network topology (attached spreadsheet) to validate routes.
> 3) Can you share an estimate (order of magnitude) for Dedicated monthly commit vs Private one-time setup + monthly ops fee?
Order of magnitude:
- Dedicated monthly reserved capacity: ~$45k–$70k/month depending on performance profile (GPU count / concurrency).
- Private VPC: one-time setup & onboarding $75k–$150k (includes deployment automation, network validation, and hardened controls) + monthly ops & maintenance $25k–$40k.
I'll have finance produce a more formal quote once we align on the config.

Attachments included: Redwood_Private_VPC_features.pdf, SOC2_Report_redacted.pdf

Proposed next step: Security deep-dive Wed 10:00 AM PT with our solutions architect (Michael). Priyom will draft a Mutual Action Plan and a short MAP to hit Q3 compliance targets. If that time works I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
